title: Introduce platform identity, member profile, group metadata, and permission resolution boundaries
description: Rust currently models MessageSender as id plus display_name and keeps plugin permissions as static owner/admin ID lists. AstrBot separates sender/member profile, group metadata, role/admin checks, and adapter-specific group/member lookup. Add a platform identity boundary before WeChat/QQ/Lark/DingTalk parity or plugin permissions grow inside adapters and filters.

files.change: Define member profile, group metadata, sender role, and privacy-safe display fields apart from MessageSession.
Normalize adapter-specific sender/member/group metadata before events enter the pipeline.
Resolve owner/admin/member permissions through platform identity data rather than static plugin filter lists only.

criteria: Adapters expose normalized identity/group metadata without leaking platform-specific DTOs into plugin filters.
Permission checks can use event identity and group role data through a typed resolver.
Core message session IDs remain routing identifiers, not a catch-all for membership state.
convergence.verification_command: cargo test -p astrbot-core && cargo test -p astrbot-platform && cargo test -p astrbot-plugin && cargo clippy --workspace -- -D warnings
